description: Maxillary third molar with 12 essential anatomical annotation points

hotspots.name: Mesiobuccal Cusp
hotspots.description: Larger of the two buccal cusps, forms the mesial-buccal corner of the occlusal surface.

hotspots.name: Distobuccal Cusp
hotspots.description: Smaller buccal cusp, forms the distal-buccal corner.
hotspots.clinical_significance: Secondary functional cusp for crushing food

hotspots.name: Lingual Cusp
hotspots.description: Single large cusp on the lingual (tongue-side) aspect.

hotspots.name: Buccal Developmental Groove
hotspots.description: Developmental groove separating the mesiobuccal and distobuccal cusps.
hotspots.clinical_significance: Common site for caries initiation, requires careful examination

hotspots.name: Central Fossa
hotspots.description: Deep central depression in the occlusal surface with multiple supplementary grooves.
hotspots.clinical_significance: High-risk area for pit and fissure caries

hotspots.name: Fused Root
hotspots.description: Single tapered root formed by fusion of originally three roots.
hotspots.clinical_significance: Important for extraction planning and endodontic treatment

hotspots.name: Mesiolingual Cusp
hotspots.description: Mesial lingual cusp in 4-cusp variant. Usually larger than distolingual cusp.

hotspots.name: Distolingual Cusp
hotspots.description: Distal lingual cusp in 4-cusp variant. Typically smaller than mesiolingual cusp.

hotspots.name: Central Developmental Groove
hotspots.description: Main developmental groove running mesiodistally, separating buccal and lingual cusps.

hotspots.name: Cervical Line (CEJ)
hotspots.description: The cervical line marking the junction between enamel (crown) and cementum (root).
hotspots.clinical_significance: Important landmark for periodontal assessment and crown preparation

hotspots.name: Occlusal Table
hotspots.description: The functional chewing surface bounded by cusps and marginal ridges.
hotspots.clinical_significance: Primary surface for mastication and occlusal contacts

hotspots.name: Root Apex
hotspots.description: Terminal end of the fused root. May be curved or irregular in third molars.
hotspots.clinical_significance: Critical landmark for endodontic treatment and extraction

metadata.notes: Essential anatomical template for maxillary third molar - 12 mandatory points
